Title: Smart Indoor Hydroponic Systems: Light, Crops & Upkeep
Description: Smart gardens light plants 12–16 h a day; lettuce needs a DLI of 12–17, about 210 µmol/m²/s for 16 h. What to check, what grows and the upkeep left. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: smart indoor hydroponic system, hydroponics, indoor gardening, hydroponic system
